usage:
require "openai"

client = Openai::Client.new(api_key: ENV["OPENAI_API_KEY"])

result = client.uploads.parts.create("upload_abc123", data: StringIO.new("Example data"))
pp result

fields.name: data
fields.description: The chunk of bytes for this Part.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The upload Part unique identifier, which can be referenced in API endpoints.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) for when the Part was created.

fields.name: upload_id
fields.description: The ID of the Upload object that this Part was added to.

fields.name: object
fields.description: The object type, which is always `upload.part`.
